historical_references.reference: The name 'Sb' is believed to be an abbreviation of the Sanskrit name 'Shiva Bhagwan'. Shiva is one of the principal deities of Hinduism, known as the god of destruction and regeneration. He is the supreme being who transcends the cyclic changes of the universe, and is responsible for the destruction of the universe so that a new one can be created. This name was prevalent during the medieval period of Indian history, around 1000-1500 AD.

Another reference suggests that 'Sb' may be an abbreviation of 'Saraswati Bhagwan'. Saraswati is the Hindu goddess of knowledge, music, arts, wisdom and learning. She is often depicted as seated on a lotus, holding a veena (a stringed musical instrument), and wearing white robes. This name was popular during the ancient and classical periods of Indian history, around 500-1000 AD.
